title: Your Segmentation Deck Is Probably Wrong
summary: Indian marketing plans often segment customers based on demographics and income.  Research shows young Indian buyers prioritize product features consistently across groups.  Storage and memory upgrades are most desired, while battery life ranks last.  Differences in customer enthusiasm and price resistance exist, not feature preference.  This suggests tailoring pricing and communication, not product variations. This research split 128 Indian phone buyers fifteen ways. The ranking never moved once.
